Tips for OneNote

Click any checkbox to tick it (Ctrl+1 adds a new one)

Tab moves to the next table cell; Tab in the last cell adds a row

Ctrl+K inserts a link to another page

Use the search box (Ctrl+E) to find anything in the planner
